lines: All that stuff had happened two days ago.
After having our strength formally recognized, we now had gathered at the location for the "part-time job."
But what is this job about in the end? They won't explain anything to us...
No idea. I tried to investigate, but I couldn't find any decent information.
Come onnnn. Fuma-kun, you're no help at all.
Ahaha! Just kidding! You only had one day to research, it is what it is, it is what it is♪
While we were chatting about various things, the "cargo" was being unloaded from a ship and transferred onto the transport trucks.
I mean, you're actually that concerned about it, huh. I thought you'd be okay with anything as long as it paid out.
Ehehe~ you're not wrong, but... I don't really want to help with something evil.
Even if the pay was high, participation in wrongdoing was out of the question. Sakura seemed to feel the same way about that.
Alright. Let's check it out stealthily.
Yeah. If we find out what this "cargo" is, their objective should become clear.
While it's still being loaded we'll watch for an opening and go look at the contents.
Ohh, great idea! But will we be able to do that...?
Even in the short distance from the ship to the trucks, the mercenaries had built several walls and were on the lookout for spying eyes.
Well, if we get a chance.
I wonder if there'll be a chance?
They seem to be expecting an attack from someone.
I see... In the ensuing confusion we can sneakily look at the contents!
Yeah. So if an attack happens, I want you to fight with as much flourish as you can to attract their attention.
Roger! If that's what you need, leave it to me! Hehe, it's like a spy movie and now I'm all excited♪
Didn't expect it, but that's exactly the situation, huh...
We were like spies who had infiltrated the enemy base, and if they found out that we were Taimanin, even our lives would be in danger, but Sakura was doing things her own way, as always.
(I'm not sure if that's reassuring or...)
A sharp alarm sounded and all the mercenaries were suddenly in a frenzy.
Enemy attack!! It's an enemy attaaaaack!!!
Ohh!! Something's coming!!? Something's flying toward us!?
For now, Sakura and I took cover behind a building near us.
Multiple small robot-like things emerged from the darkness.
And from behind them, loud metallic sounds could be heard, and figures resembling fully-equipped soldiers appeared.
(I've seen those before at some point. UFS combat drones and soldiers, huh. Quite impressive.)
Soon gunshots and explosions echoed from the surroundings. It appeared that the battle between the drones and the mercenaries had begun.
Seems like it started. Sakura, are you ready?
Yep! If it's against the UFS I can fight without holding back! I've got to work hard to earn my pay!
We, too, jumped out from behind the wall and confronted the drones flying about.
